title: Parts Technician - D. Open and fill an in-progress inspection
preconds: Logged in as Parts Technician. Work Order Lines = View only. A line has an in-progress inspection (incl. on an approved line for Tech View roles).
steps:
1. Log in.
2. Open an in-progress inspection on a line (click Open).
3. Attempt to fill/edit the inspection items.
expected:
Step 2: The inspection can be opened to VIEW only.
Step 3: Items cannot be filled/edited - role lacks WOL Create and Edit; the inspection opens read-only and Submit/Generate Report is hidden (SV-8095 AC2).
